The hook would let smaller and more organic flow trade against the public pool as normal, while larger trades would be routed through an authenticated OTC-style path with explicit permissions, clip-size controls, and settlement protections. In simple terms, the visible pool remains the public market shell, but large flow gets a more controlled route. This is not meant to be a fully dark exchange. That would be too heavy and probably not the right first step. desc: Ultramar Port of Call is a Yield-Protected AMM pattern for private operating-business capital: investors receive a signed passport and enter fixed, capped Uniswap v4 capital windows instead of exposing issuer inventory to passive public LP impermanent-loss risk. The hook enforces router-bound authorization, exact-input settlement, oracle freshness, caps, blocked public liquidity, and beforeSwapReturnDelta custom accounting for yield-bearing capital routes.

name: HedgeFlow
desc: HedgeFlow is an adaptive liquidity protection protocol for Uniswap v4 that dynamically adjusts trading fees based on real-time risk scoring, and automatically compensates LPs for impermanent   loss from a shared reserve vault when they withdraw — powered by an AI risk engine, Reactive Network automation, and an on-chain IL calculator.

name: STRATUM
tags: Custom hooks,CFMM,Constant Product Market Maker (CPMM),LP Fees,LP Liquidity,Dynamic Fee,LVR,Basic Interest Rate,Cross-Chain,Unichain,Inter-Connected Pools,zk-SNARK,Machine Learning
desc: STRATUM is a structured credit primitive for Uniswap v4 - the first hook to apply credit subordination to AMM liquidity. It splits a liquidity position into a fixed-yield, IL-protected senior tranche and a leveraged-fee, IL-absorbing junior tranche through an on-chain priority waterfall.

name: StructuredYield
tags: Unichain,Custom hooks,LP Liquidity,Yield Farming,Options/Futures,LP Fees,Security,Custom Routers
desc: StructuredYield is a Uniswap v4 Hook that separates impermanent loss risk from trading fees by splitting standard LP positions into a principal-protected tranche (PT-LP) and a leveraged yield tranche (YT-LP). This architecture enables risk-free liquidity provision for conservative capital, while allowing risk-seeking users to speculate purely on swap fee revenue.

name: Hedgeman
desc: Automatically pair opposing LP positions across correlated pools. When one side exits, emit a real-USDC rebalance signal. No oracles. No in-callback token movement.

name: Maestro
desc: Maestro is an auction-managed AMM (am-AMM) Uniswap v4 hook that recaptures the value LPs normally lose to arbitrage (Loss-Versus-Rebalancing) and pays it back to them as per-block rent. The pool manager is not a human or a bot but an autonomous cross-chain Reactive Smart Contract that tracks the live Pyth ETH/USD price and re-concentrates the liquidity on its own.

name: EvenFlow
desc: EvenFlow is a Uniswap v4 hook that turns an oracle-free directional-toxicity fee into a yield-smoothing system: it escrows the toxicity premium during adverse flow and drips it back to in-range LPs once the market goes quiet, with a Reactive Network cron releasing stranded reserve cross-chain even when no swaps happen.

name: Vixa
tags: Unichain,LVR,Custom hooks,LP Liquidity,CFMM,LP Fees,Cross-Chain,Dynamic Tick Adjustment,Options/Futures
desc: Vixa is a Uniswap v4 hook that splits a single LP deposit into two sub-positions whose delta exposures  cancel each other so this becomes a structural hedge against impermanent loss. Both legs earn fees continuously, with no external protocols, oracles, or keeper infrastructure required.

name: PegGuard - Measured IL Insurance
desc: PegGuard is a Uniswap v4 dynamic-fee hook that turns LVR/correcting flow into measured IL insurance for LPs. It uses a Pyth-priced hot path and a Reactive Network volatility control plane, with every parameter calibrated against real on-chain replay data.

name: Bequeath
tags: LP Fees,LP Liquidity,Yield Farming,LP Fees,LP Liquidity,Yield Farming,Other,Heir Succession
desc: Bequeath is a Uniswap v4 hook that self-funds a smoothed monthly income stream from an LP's own realized fees, parked in an ERC-4626 yield vault and transfers that living stream to a beneficiary if the owner goes inactive, making a DeFi yield position inheritable

name: dnhook
desc: Delta Neutral Hook is a Uniswap v4 project exploring how a market-making pool can account for inventory risk on-chain, expose hedge intent to an external keeper, and use dynamic fees to guide order flow while the system returns toward delta neutrality.

name: ReactiveShield  IL Insurance Hook
tags: Impermanent Loss Insurance,Uniswap v4 Hook,Reactive Smart Contracts,Autonomous Settlement,LP Protection,Reserve-Backed Insurance,Yield Systems,Aave Adapter,Risk Management,Onchain Mutual Insurance
desc: ReactiveShield is a Uniswap v4 impermanent-loss insurance hook that lets LPs opt into reserve-backed IL coverage with a chosen deductible threshold. Reactive Smart Contracts on Reactive Network monitor hook events and autonomously trigger payouts through the callback proxy, removing the need for keepers, bots, multisigs, or manual claims.

name: Unistrata
tags: Yield Farming,Cross-Chain,Pool Native Incentivization,Unichain,LP Liquidity,Oracle,Stablecoins,Basic Interest Rate,LP Fees
desc: Unistrata is a Uniswap v4 hook that prices a single pool as a capital structure: a senior tranche (Bedrock) with protected principal and a coupon priced from the pool's own realized variance, over a junior first-loss tranche (Sediment) that underwrites the volatility in exchange for the excess fees. Epoch settlement fires cross-chain via a Reactive Network contract — no keeper, no bot, and no external price oracle.

name: BOB - Belief-Oriented Buyback
desc: BOB is a Uniswap v4 hook for conviction-aligned LPing. It lets maxis support liquidity and earn yield while staying closer to the asset they actually believe in.

name: SafeSwap
desc: Trustless MEV protection and LVR rebate for LPs

name: TRIDENT
desc: Trident is a Uniswap v4 hook that protects LPs from impermanent loss through three autonomous layers: arb-detection fees that charge arbitrageurs proportionally, gamma-aware boundary premiums that compensate LPs at range edges, and an on-chain IL reserve vault that pays out at withdrawal — all driven by Reactive Network cross-chain automation.

name: FxHedgeHook — Delta-Neutral IL Shield for a FX Yield Machine
desc: FxHedgeHook is a Uniswap v4 hook that tracks LP exposure on FX/BTC pools in real time and   auto-opens offsetting short perps on our on-chain clearinghouse, neutralizing impermanent   loss so LPs keep the full spread + yield. It's the IL shield of a larger "yield machine"   where empty-pool delta-accounting (FxSwapHook) lets the same capital earn Morpho/USYC yield   between swaps.

name: VolatilityVault
desc: VolatilityVault is a Uniswap V4 hook that uses a Reactive Network smart contract and an AI volatility score to raise swap fees before arbitrage bots strike, then routes those storm-period fees into a yield-bearing buffer that pays LPs back with compounded yield. LPs set their intent once and the system protects their position automatically.

name: YieldStream Hook
tags: Uniswap v4 Hooks,Yield Tokenization,Fixed Income,LP Fee Markets,Impermanent Loss,Structured Yield,Reactive Smart Contracts,Autonomous Settlement,Epoch-Based Settlement,DeFi Derivatives,ERC-20 Claim Tokens
desc: YieldStream Hook is a Uniswap v4 hook that splits a hook-managed LP position into two transferable ERC-20 claims: FYT, a claim on the epoch’s future fee stream, and PT, a claim on the epoch’s principal. Reactive Network observes backed fee-accrual events and autonomously triggers epoch settlement on Lasna without a keeper, bot, multisig, or manual settlement transaction.

name: Mochi Yield
tags: LP Fees,Dynamic Fee,ETH Staking,Yield Farming,Custom hooks,Price Discovery,LVR
desc: Mochi Yield is a Uniswap v4 hook that turns yield-bearing assets like wstETH into tradable Principal (PT) and Yield (YT) tokens, with maturity-aware fees, implied-rate guards, and cross-pool parity enforcement. It brings fixed-income market discipline to AMMs so LPs and traders can separate principal safety from yield speculation without selling the underlying.

name: HookMind
desc: HookMind is a non-custodial Uniswap v4 hook that protects liquidity providers from impermanent loss with an on-chain "Market Airbag" that auto-enrolls at deposit, while an AI agent adjusts fees to live volatility. Every fee decision is ECDSA-signed and pinned to IPFS for a full on-chain audit trail.

name: DynamicLPFeesHook
desc: Instead of using a fixed fee for every swap, the hook compares the current Uniswap pool price with a Chainlink ETH/USD reference price. When the pool price moves further away from the oracle reference price, the hook increases the swap fee so liquidity providers are better compensated for higher execution risk.

name: DeltaNeutral Vault Hook
tags: Delta-Neutral Hooks,Impermanent Loss Mitigation,LP Hedging,Reactive Smart Contracts,Uniswap v4 Hooks,Event-Driven Automation,Reactive Network,Risk Management,Hedge Adapter,Perp Hedging,Yield Systems,Unichain Sepolia
desc: DeltaNeutral Vault Hook is a Uniswap v4 hook that monitors LP delta exposure after swaps and uses Reactive Network to autonomously trigger hedge adjustments when pool exposure drifts outside a configured dead band. It proves a full hook-to-RSC-to-callback flow on Unichain Sepolia and Reactive Lasna, reducing unmanaged impermanent-loss exposure without keepers or off-chain bots.

name: ILAwareLimitOrderHook
desc: A Uniswap V4 hook that turns every limit order into a yield-bearing, IL-aware position: the filled output earns vault yield, and impermanent loss is computed on-chain from sqrtPriceX96 (no oracle) and rebated from that yield. Live on Unichain mainnet - orders are ERC-721 NFTs, 53 tests passing.

name: Sochalant
desc: A Uniswap v4 hook that splits LP positions into senior/junior tranches (70/30) and dynamically adjusts hedging based on an on-chain risk score computed from price delta, swap volume, and volatility — no oracles or keepers required.

name: Schrodinger Hook
tags: Security,Compliance,MEV,DEX,LP Fees,Dynamic Fee,Tokenized Stocks,Regulation,Custom hooks,Pool Native Incentivization,LP Liquidity,RWA,Stablecoins,Yield Farming,Private Debt
desc: Schrodinger Hook is a private rebalancing hook.

tags: LP Fees,Compliance,Dynamic Fee,Trading Rewards,LP Liquidity,LVR,Yield Farming,Constant Product Market Maker (CPMM),Inter-Connected Pools,RWA,Reputation,Custom hooks
desc: We didn't just build insurance; we split the LP position into its core components so that yield can compound safely and risk can be traded freely.

name: hookeeper
desc: HooKeeper is an autonomous cross-chain protection system that utilizes Uniswap V4 hooks to detect Impermanent Loss and NEAR Chain Signatures to privately redistribute arbitrage profits back to affected Liquidity Providers. It maintains ecosystem stability by "recycling" value from external bots on chains like Terra and Injective while triggering emergency liquidity boosts on Osmosis during periods of high volatility.

name: Indemnify
desc: Indemnifi is on-chain insurance for Uniswap v4 liquidity providers, letting LPs buy explicit impermanent-loss coverage directly through a v4 hook. Premiums are backed by an insurance vault, while Reactive Network monitors pool events and automates claim settlement when covered losses occur.

name: ThroneHook
tags: Trading Volume Rewards,Engagement Mechanics,Competitive Leaderboard,Community Layer
desc: ThroneHook is a Uniswap v4 hook that routes a share of swap fees to the most active traders in a pool via two competitive thrones: Frequency (most swaps) and Volume (highest input). The goal is to add a community engagement layer to any pool.

desc: A

name: EigenAuction
desc: Arbitrage auction mechanism based on EigenLayer AVS which reduce LVR for liquidity providers.

name: Squid
desc: Squid is a cross-chain data observability and automation solution for passive LPs. It turns passive LPing from a blind yield bet into a data-driven, monitorable, and eventually automated strategy.

name: Premium Yield Hook
tags: LP Fees,Yield Farming,LP Liquidity,Constant Product Market Maker (CPMM),Dynamic Tick Adjustment,Dynamic Fee,Custom hooks
desc: PremiumYield is a Uniswap v4 hook that solves the single biggest barrier to passive LP participation: impermanent loss (IL). Instead of reacting to IL after it happens, PremiumYield builds a structurally capitalized, yield-bearing insurance fund directly into the liquidity layer.

name: Holdfast
tags: LVR,Yield Farming,LP Liquidity,Pool Native Incentivization,Liquidity Mining,Trading Rewards,Trading Volume Rewards,Reputation,Dynamic Fee,LP Fees
desc: A Uniswap v4 hook that measures IL exposure, partially compensates realized impermanent loss, and compounds rewards through Aave V3.

name: Fixed-Income Tranche Hook
tags: Uniswap v4 Hook,Fixed Income,Structured Products,LP Tranching,Impermanent Loss,Yield Systems,Reactive Network,RSC,Epoch Settlement,ERC-20 Tranche Tokens,Senior/Junior Liquidity,Aave Adapter
desc: Fixed-Income Tranche Hook brings structured finance to Uniswap v4 by splitting LP capital into senior and junior ERC-20 tranches. Senior LPs receive fixed-priority yield, while junior LPs absorb impermanent loss and fee shortfalls in exchange for residual upside, with epoch settlement automated through Reactive Network.

name: Reactive-Delta-Shield
desc: The Reactive Delta-Shield (RDS) is an autonomous, self-funding delta-hedging engine designed for Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity providers (LPs). By integrating a Uniswap v4 hook with the Reactive Network, the system isolates a fraction of swap fees in real-time to serve as dedicated hedging collateral.

name: DualTranche Vault
desc: A Uniswap v4 hook that eliminates idle capital and bad-entry timing for concentrated liquidity LPs by splitting every pool into two volatility-aware tranches — Senior and Junior — each with distinct risk/reward profiles, coordinated by a single shared on-chain volatility signal.

name: Prism
desc: Prism is a Uniswap v4 hook that splits every LP deposit into two tokens: LP-Y, which earns full swap fees with zero impermanent loss, and LP-D, which absorbs the IL and is auto-sold to protocols bidding for it via an on-chain standing-bid market. LPs exit whole no matter what price does — IL is paid from the buyer's USDC collateral vault, computed oracle-free from pool prices alone.

name: Steady
desc: Steady is a cross-chain automated savings protocol that lets users set up recurring on-chain DCA plans — “buy $50 of ETH every week” — which execute themselves trustlessly via the Reactive Network, with no off-chain keeper.  A Uniswap v4 dynamic-fee hook makes every recurring savings swap completely fee-free.

name: sentry
desc: Sentry is a Uniswap V4 hook that taxes short-lived liquidity positions on an exponential decay curve (65% at t=0, near 0% after ~1.7 hours) and redistributes the captured fees to long-term LPs who have held for over 24 hours, using the Reactive Network to trigger cross-chain redistributions automatically. It defends loyal liquidity providers from JIT (just-in-time) MEV bots that sandwich swaps without contributing real liquidity depth.

name: ReactiveHedge
tags: LVR,Cross-Chain,Custom hooks,Dynamic Tick Adjustment,Unichain,Options/Futures,Oracle,Constant Product Market Maker (CPMM),LP Liquidity,MEV,Yield Farming,Dynamic Fee
desc: When an LP adds liquidity to your v4 pool, the hook automatically opens a delta-neutral short on Hyperliquid (or a mock perp for the demo) sized to the LP's net delta exposure. A Reactive Smart Contract continuously monitors net delta as the pool price drifts, and fires cross-chain callbacks to rebalance the hedge.

name: Schizō
desc: schizō turns each Uniswap v4 LP position into two tradeable tokens ; one that collects fees, one that bears impermanent loss : creating an on-chain bond market for IL, with a Reactive Smart Contract marking positions to market on every swap.

name: Aqua0 Options-Straddler
desc: We are building on top of our last cohort's shared liquidity pool - this time we are mitigating impermanent loss via automatic execution of options.

name: PostHook
tags: LP Fees,Dynamic Fee,Custom hooks,Stablecoins,Unichain,LP Liquidity,Cross-Chain,Yield Farming
desc: Posthook is a consumer gift card powered by a Uniswap v4 dynamic-fee hook and Reactive Network: you deposit two stablecoins into a v4 LP position that earns a premium swap fee while unclaimed, so the gift grows in transit — and a Reactive Smart Contract automates the cross-chain claim, unwinding the position on Unichain and delivering the proceeds on Base.

name: Cleave
desc: A Uniswap v4 hook that turns LP positions into fixed-income products: Pendle, but for liquidity. The first time yield tokenization works for volatile-pair AMM liquidity, made possible by v4's hook-level custody and a watermark mechanism that protects principal during impermanent loss.

name: Atlas
desc: Atlas is a Uniswap v4 hook that pairs every LP add with a delta-matched perpetual short and pays a flat 8% APR through an ERC-4626 vault. A Reactive Smart Contract on Reactive Lasna watches the on-chain oracle and rebalances the hedge cross-chain in 15-20 seconds, fully observable on testnet.

name: TrancheGuard
desc: TrancheGuard is a Uniswap v4 hook for tranche-based impermanent-loss insurance — Senior LPs are protected up to a buffer while Junior LPs absorb the first loss for a larger fee share — with both parameters derived from a Monte-Carlo IL simulation, not guessed.

name: Hedgehog
desc: Hedgehog is a Uniswap v4 hook that auto-hedges LP impermanent loss via EigenLayer-secured, cross-chain GMX short positions — fee income without directional risk.

name: CrossPoolHedger Hook
tags: Impermanent Loss,Cross-Pool Hedging,Uniswap v4 Hooks,Reactive Network,LP Risk Management,Event-Driven Automation,Correlated Pools,ReactVM,Autonomous Rebalancing,DeFi Risk Infrastructure
desc: CrossPoolHedger Hook is a Uniswap v4 hook that coordinates LP exposure across two correlated pools, such as ETH/USDC and ETH/stETH. A Reactive Network RSC monitors exposure events from both pools, computes combined imbalance, and triggers a hedge callback when cross-pool IL drift exceeds a threshold.

name: LaminarY
desc: LaminarY is a Uniswap v4 hook that splits every LP position into a Principal Token with time-decaying IL exposure and a Yield Token representing the full fee stream — protected by a self-compounding IL Reserve that grows stronger the longer the pool runs. No escrow. No perp hedge. No external dependencies. Just math and time.

name: SamanaHook - IL Insurance for Committed Liquidity
tags: LP Liquidity,Price Discovery,ICO,Pool Native Incentivization,Liquidity Mining
desc: Anyone who needs committed liquidity during a high-IL window funds a bounty. LPs who remain collect a base reward plus an IL payout proportional to the IL suffered.

name: Anchor
desc: Anchor is an AI-powered LP protection system built on **Uniswap v4 hooks** and **Reactive Network** and deloyed on unichain sepolia. It predicts impermanent loss before it compounds, automatically adjusts liquidity exposure via SentryRSC, and locks in profits into a Protection Vault before gains disappear.

name: Smooth IL
desc: A Uniswap v4 hook that reduces impermanent loss for long-term LPs by paying capped, tenure-weighted reimbursements from a smoothing reserve, with settlement automated through Reactive Network.

name: TrancheShield
desc: TrancheShield is a Uniswap v4 hook that protects liquidity providers from impermanent loss by splitting them into Senior (protected) and Junior (underwriting) tranches, with the protection funded by a slice of swap fees instead of token emissions. A Reactive Network smart contract prices the pool's risk in real time adjusting the dynamic fee, IL coverage, and deposit gating cross-chain as volatility, reserve health, and withdrawal pressure change.

name: CrossHedge — CoW for LP risk
tags: Unichain,LVR,Cross-Chain,LP Liquidity,LP Fees,Impermanent Loss Protection,CoW for LP Risk,Cross-Chain LP Netting,Reactive Smart Contracts,ERC-4626 Yield Vault,Peer-to-Peer Risk Matching,Delta Hedging,Real Yield,Inter-Connected Pools
desc: CrossHedge is a Uniswap v4 hook that hedges impermanent loss by matching LPs with opposing risk peer-to-peer across chains, with an ERC-4626 vault as the always-available counterparty. The matching engine runs entirely on-chain via Reactive Network, no bridge, no keeper, no off-chain solver, and redirects the $60-120M/year that LPs currently leak to arbitrageurs back to LPs and vault depositors.

name: Brook
tags: LP Fees,Dynamic Fee,Basic Interest Rate,Custom Routers,Yield Farming,Unichain
desc: Brook is a Uniswap v4 hook that turns unpredictable swap fees into steady, paycheck-style income for liquidity providers. It holds a slice of each swap fee in a buffer and streams it out the following epoch, weighted by who actually stayed in range.

name: FlowPass
desc: FlowPass is a Uniswap v4 fee-smoothing yield hook that sells prepaid trading passes: traders pay upfront for discounted future swap volume, and the hook tracks quota and expiry per wallet. The pass revenue is split into LP reserve and treasury revenue, while the discount helps retain recurring order flow in competitive pools.

name: Eleos
desc: Eleos is a Uniswap v4 hook that automatically recaptures impermanent loss for liquidity providers, funded by a percentage of the swap fees traders already pay. A loyalty-weighted vault rewards patient LPs who stay through volatility while redistributing forfeited recapture from early exiters with idle vault capital deployable to any ERC-4626 yield protocol like Aave

name: IdentiFI Protocol
desc: A local-first privacy framework for Uniswap v4. It uses a client-side Rust/WASM generator to build authorization payloads that the beforeSwap hook validates before allowing trades.

name: Goldgard
desc: Goldgard is a hook that protects LST LP yield through oracle‑aware dynamic fees, circuit breaking and post‑swap delta rebalancing funded by a 0.02% insurance premium flowing into an ERC‑4626 Safety vault.

name: Intent LP
desc: IntentLP is a Uniswap v4 beforeSwap hook that lets LPs register on-chain conditions (volume range, time window, slippage tolerance) so swaps violating their intent pay a penalty fee instead of routing at the base rate — turning uncontrolled toxic flow into compensated risk. It integrates Chainlink price feeds, Circle USDC streaming rewards, and Across Protocol cross-chain bridging in a single gas-optimized hook with 63 passing tests and a live frontend.

name: lambda
desc: Lambda turns the money liquidity providers quietly lose into money they earn. The first Uniswap v4 hook that hedges every LP position on a real perpetual market automatically and cross-chain — Unichain → Hyperliquid, driven by Reactive Smart Contracts with no off-chain bot in the loop. Lambda the hook catches λ before it leaves.

name: FluxShield - Adaptive fee hook for UniswapV4
desc: FluxShield is an adaptive fee hook for Uniswap v4 that uses Chainlink price feeds to detect market‑AMM deviation and dynamically escalates swap fees, protecting liquidity providers from arbitrage extraction while preserving price synchronization

name: SCRATCHIN
desc: SCRATCHIN is a fully on-chain scratch card lottery game where players buy NFT cards with USDC, and block-hash entropy reveals three symbols automatically match two for a small win, match three for the jackpot funded by real Uniswap V4 swap fees.

name: LiquiShield
desc: LiquiShield is a Uniswap v4 Hook-based impermanent loss insurance protocol that allows liquidity providers to purchase protection directly within the LP lifecycle. By combining lifecycle-aware hooks, concentrated liquidity risk modeling, a TWAP-based pricing mechanism, and an ERC-4626 insurance vault, LiquiShield transforms LP positions into safer and more predictable yield-generating assets.

name: Veritas: Provenance-Aware Impermanent Loss Protection
desc: Veritas is a Uniswap v4 system that converts content-authenticity data into an on-chain Dilution Risk Score (DRS), a single number that simultaneously gates IP tokenization to block copied or AI-replicated content from raising capital, and calibrates LP fee protection in the resulting graduated pools, creating the first trustless end-to-end lifecycle for creator economy assets from verified origination to deep liquidity.We integrated Reactive Network as a core trust primitive for the Living DRS system. A DilutionMonitorRSC contract runs live on Reactive's Lasna network and subscribes to NewAttestation events emitted by VeritasRegistry on Unichain Sepolia. When any near-duplicate of an attested content token appears on-chain, the RSC fires a cross-chain callback to VeritasRegistryCallback on Unichain, autonomously incrementing that content's dilutionCount: no keeper, no cron, no oracle needed. This raises the DRS of the original asset, which immediately elevates the LP fee on its next swap. This is load-bearing: without this, D could only be pushed upward by the off-chain oracle, which is signable and therefore bribeable. The on-chain dilutionCount floor from Reactive means no oracle can suppress D below what the blockchain itself has already witnessed. Proven live on 2026-06-06: dilutionCount raised 0 to 2 end-to-end, DilutionIncremented events confirmed, with zero off-chain infrastructure running.

name: ΔShield Protocol
tags: LP Fees,MEV,Cross-Chain,Dynamic fee,Custom Hooks,Pool Native Incentivization,LP Liquidity,Oracle,Unichain,Yield Farming,LVR,Impermanent Loss
desc: ΔShield is a Uniswap v4 hook that captures a portion of arbitrage profits at the hook level and routes them into an LP protection reserve, reducing impermanent loss over time. It also splits LP positions into principal and yield components, so liquidity providers earn from ongoing arb flow instead of only absorbing its downside.

name: TrancheHook
desc: TrancheHook is a Uniswap v4 hook that splits any LP position into a Principal Token (redeems at fixed $1 face value at maturity) and a Yield Token (earns all swap fees, absorbs impermanent loss first), bringing fixed-income structured products natively to the AMM layer.

name: RangeGuard
desc: A Uniswap v4 hook providing native on-chain impermanent loss coverage for LPs, funded by dynamic fee skimming and powered by the Reactive Network for autonomous cross-chain automation

name: TokenLaunchHook Studio
desc: V4 hook attached to a newly launched token's pool. Enforces fair-launch rules (anti-snipe, dynamic LP fee tax, conditional liquidity lock, whitelist phase) without modifying the ERC-20 token contract.

name: BackStop
tags: LP Fees,DEX,Dynamic Fee,LP Liquidity,Impermanent Loss,Yield Systems
desc: BackStop is an impermanent loss insurance marketplace built as a Uniswap v4 hook. Think Aave Umbrella, but for IL. LPs get automatic protection while underwriters earn a new on-chain yield primitive.

name: Helix
desc: Helix is a Uniswap v4 hook that mutualizes impermanent loss across a basket of correlation-diversified LP positions — matching providers whose IL exposure offsets each other and redistributing surplus at settlement so each member converges toward the basket's average IL instead of absorbing their own in full. It uses Reactive Smart Contracts to autonomously monitor cross-chain price correlation and volatility, triggering re-matching or pausing when a basket's risk assumptions break down.

name: Kinematic Protocol
desc: Kinematic Protocol hopes to serve as an automatic money shifter for people who provide Bitcoin to help others trade on Uniswap.

name: LiquidityOrchestrate
desc: Liquidity Orchestrate is a DeFi automation protocol built on Uniswap v4 that automatically detects idle liquidity positions and rebalances them into active trading ranges to maximize capital efficiency and fee generation. Using custom hooks and automated upkeep logic, the protocol helps liquidity providers earn higher returns while reducing the need for manual position management.

name: Devia
desc: Devia is a deviation-aware Uniswap v4 hook that dynamically increases swap fees under oracle uncertainty: driven by price deviation and stale updates, reducing LP losses from toxic arbitrage flow. Keepers restore pool-to-market alignment through KeeperExecutor entrypoint, earning a share of subsequent swap fees. Instead of rewarding stale-price extraction, Devia redistributes value toward LPs and accurate keepers.

name: DobDex
desc: A Liquid Real World Asset DEX where anyone can provide instant exit liquidity, allowing investors to sell their shares of an asset at any time. All assets are regulated at the moment of registration through a decentralized validation procedure.

name: Tokenized Strategies on UniV4 Hook
tags: Specialized Markets,Tokenized LP Strategies,Yield-Bearing Shares,Hook Policy Engine,Dynamic Swap Guards,Secondary Liquidity,DeFi Collateral
desc: Tokenized Strategies on UniV4 Hook is a Uniswap v4 hook + vault system that packages LP yield into transferable ERC20 strategy shares (yToken). It enforces deterministic swap-policy and accounting so users can mint/redeem, trade on a secondary market, and use shares as collateral with verifiable onchain proof.

name: SuperHook

name: Chain Localized Routing Hook
tags: Specialized Markets,Chain-Localized Routing,Uniswap v4 Hooks,Policy Engine,Deterministic Execution Guards,Dynamic Fee Controls,Router Allowlist/Denylist,L2 Execution Constraints
desc: A Uniswap v4 hook that enforces deterministic chain-localized routing policies at swap execution time. Pools can apply chain-specific limits, cooldowns, gas ceilings, and allowlist/denylist rules directly in beforeSwap, with reason-coded onchain outcomes.

name: ThetaSwap
desc: ThetaSwap builds the first on-chain adverse competition oracle: the Fee Concentration Index (FCI) Hook tracks fee share distribution across protocols (Uniswap V3 via Reactive Network, V4 natively) and derives an index that prices the insurance-relevant deviation from the competitive equilibrium baseline.

name: Liquidity Lock And Token Lauch Hook
tags: Specialized Markets,Uniswap v4 Hook,Launch Protection,Liquidity Locking,Anti-Snipe,Volume-Gated Unlocks,Deterministic Policy Engine,Permissionless Progression
desc: A Uniswap v4 hook + launch manager + vault that locks launch liquidity and only unlocks it when deterministic on-chain conditions are met (time, cumulative volume, and optional stability band). It enforces anti-snipe limits during swap execution and supports permissionless unlock progression without keepers.

name: Bayex
desc: Bayex is a hook that allows trading of Conditional tokens(Prediction Markets outcome tokens)

name: Orbitwork
desc: Orbitwork is a trustless escrow protocol that utilizes Uniswap v4 hooks to generate yield on escrowed funds during the contract period. It ensures freelancers receive "yield bonuses" while providing clients with a secure, milestone-based payment system.

name: reCEPTION-hook

This design lets RWA issuers, institutional LPs, and compliant frontends plug into Uniswap v4 while preserving user privacy and minimizing regulatory friction. It also keeps the hook modular: pools can configure which compliance profile they require (e.g. “KYC+sanctions only”, “EU-only”, “18+ only”), and the same hook can serve multiple pools with different rule-sets. The end goal is to make Uniswap v4 a first-class venue for regulated and permissioned capital flows, without sacrificing decentralization or composability.

Imagine a world where your most profitable on-chain strategies execute themselves at the perfect moment, without any manual intervention. • Automated Strategy Execution: Define your strategy once, and let ShadowBrain handle the rest. Your actions are executed automatically when the precise market conditions are met.

ShadowBrain is building the intelligent trigger layer that DeFi has been missing, paving the way for a more efficient, secure, and truly autonomous on-chain world.
